title: The indie game community is in disarray over AI and Big Walk
original_title: The indie game community is in disarray over AI and Big Walk
summary: Some Independent Games Festival (IGF) jurors published a statement yesterday saying they would not vote for games that use generative AI in "any capacity." Soon after, the developer of indie hit Big…
title_zh: 独立游戏节评委拒绝投给生成式作品
lead_zh: The Verge 报道，部分独立游戏节评委声明，不会投票给以任何方式使用生成式人工智能的游戏。游戏《Big Walk》的开发者则说自己只用了一点点，用来解决技术难题。
